name: web-accounting-site-on-laptop-atop-black-plinth
title: Accounting firm site on a laptop placed on a black plinth in a dark studio
whatItIs: A laptop showing a white website with royal-blue accents and a team photo sits on a black cube in a black void, lit softly from one side.
whatItMeans: Formal and focused; the void makes the bright screen the only subject.
techniques: Stage the laptop on a plinth in a fully black scene.
Let one side light reveal the edges.
Keep the website white to glow.
Leave large empty areas for a premium feel.
bestFor: Professional services and corporate site covers

vocabulary.definition: Placing a device on a block like a museum object.
Light that only reveals the edges of an object.
